independent_checks.method: Read retained JSONL and independently recomputed medians, paired ratios, joins and sums in JavaScript without invoking the campaign or its jq aggregator; inspected analyze.jq and compared every summary cell and six report table rows plus paired-result prose.

interpretation_checks: Pairing uses matching size, trial and workload, never operation position or a ratio of separate medians. The jq helper can drop malformed pair groups, so all actual groups were independently checked for exactly one warm and one whole observation.

Whole is equally prepared whole-object zstd with Raw fallback. Every Whole object operation chose Raw on these incompressible fixtures. Seed and unrelated application frames/counts agree between arms; tiny envelope differences are not a compression benefit.

The warm arm pays its extra schema publication. All setup, probe, seed and operation costs are included in lifecycle sums; fixture generation and final reporting/readback/cleanup remain outside these timing sums as documented.
The 1 MiB unrelated paired CPU penalty is retained despite the opposite ordering of separate medians. Three trials provide an observed result, not general performance acceptance.
The 600-byte HTTP model is distinct from roughly 22.6 KB canonical warm envelopes and roughly 31.9 MB full 16 MiB canonical exchanges. Selector optimality under the new framing is not claimed.
This is one host InMemoryPeerTransport campaign. No live guest/vsock, network-send time, WAN, separate endpoint CPU, energy, FIPS/CUI or production mailbox lifecycle qualification is implied.
